project_type: React Native + Expo cross-platform app (iOS, Android, Web) with Expo Router file-based navigation
build_system: Expo (expo start / expo start --web). No separate compile step. TypeScript checked via npx tsc --noEmit. Quirk: strict mode enabled in tsconfig.json, moduleResolution: bundler.
test_framework: vitest 5.0.2 — property-based tests using fast-check for utility functions only. No UI component tests.
verification_instructions: 1) Run 'npx tsc --noEmit' from workspace root — must have zero errors. 2) Run 'npx vitest --run' — all 18 existing tests must pass. These are the only automated checks available; visual verification requires Expo dev server.
environment_constraints: Do not start the Expo dev server. Do not push to remote. Commit locally on branch 'feat/dashboard-ui-refinement'. Use 'git add <specific-file>' not 'git add .'
contribution_requirements: All colors from useTheme().tokens — never hardcode hex values. All spacing from token values — no magic numbers (note: some values like fontSize:13 and lineHeight:20 have no exact token match but are part of the established sectionTitle style pattern). StyleSheet.create via makeStyles(tokens) factory for standalone components. index.tsx uses a module-level s = StyleSheet.create({}) with tokens passed inline via style prop arrays — this is the pre-existing pattern, continue it. No new dependencies.
key_patterns:
makeStyles(tokens) factory pattern: standalone components (ProductivityScore, GoalSetting) define 'function makeStyles(tokens: ReturnType<typeof useTheme>["tokens"])' returning StyleSheet.create({...}). Called as 'const styles = makeStyles(tokens)' after 'const { tokens } = useTheme()'. index.tsx uses module-level 's = StyleSheet.create({})' and 'st = StyleSheet.create({})' — tokens are passed inline via JSX style arrays like [s.someStyle, { color: tokens.textMuted }].

Established sectionTitle pattern (from Statistics tab): { fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600', lineHeight: 20, flex: 1 } — NO textTransform, NO letterSpacing. Small uppercase metadata labels (TODAY, STREAK) keep { fontSize: 10, fontWeight: '700', letterSpacing: 0.7 }.

Card border pattern: borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth (not 1).

Text-overflow rule: every Text style needs explicit lineHeight (fontSize 12 → lineHeight 18, fontSize 14 → lineHeight 20, fontSize 11 → lineHeight 16, fontSize 10 → lineHeight 14).
key_token_names: bgPrimary, bgSecondary, bgTertiary, bgInput, bgAccentSoft, bgElevated, accentPrimaryLight; borderPrimary, borderSecondary; textPrimary, textSecondary, textMuted; accentBlue, accentGreen, accentOrange, accentRed, accentPurple, accentPrimary, accentPrimaryMuted, accentPrimaryLight; spacing.xs=4, sm=8, md=12, lg=16, xl=24, xxl=32, xxxl=48; typography.display=32, title=24, heading=20, subheading=17, body=15, caption=13, label=11; StyleSheet.hairlineWidth for thin borders
directory_structure: app/(tabs)/index.tsx — main dashboard screen with OverviewTab (stats grid, progress card, Heatmap, GoalSetting, ProductivityScore), StatisticsTab (already refined), ActivityTab (7-day grid, recent activity feed) as inline sub-components; src/components/planner/ — standalone components (WeeklyReport done, LineChart done, ProductivityScore needs work, GoalSetting needs work); src/components/calendar/Heatmap.tsx — heatmap with mobile monthly and desktop 52-week views (needs work); src/theme/tokens.ts — DARK_TOKENS and LIGHT_TOKENS; .agents/tasks/ — plan artifacts (outside worktree, never committed)
